description.title: השתתפות עצמית
description.summary: This table details the deductible amounts applicable to a car insurance policy. It specifies the maximum deductible amounts for both non-pecuniary damages and loss of earnings.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח לרכב פרטי ומסחרי כוללת השתתפות עצמית. סכום ההשתתפות העצמית עבור נזקים שאינם ממוניים לא יעלה על 25,000 ש״ח, ועבור אובדן השתכרות – 7 ימי עבודה. תנאים אלו חלים בהתאם לתקנות הפיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים.
description.row_axis: Types of deductible (e.g., non-pecuniary damages, loss of earnings)

sketch:
4. Deductible
4.1 The insurer shall be entitled to set-off a deductible in regard to the driver whose name appears on the insurance certificate, upon fulfillment of the stipulation in regard to a deductible in accordance with the Motor Vehicle Insurance Regulations (Deductible) (Temporary Order) 5769-2008 including when the policy owner selects a policy which includes a stipulation in regard to a deductible, a choice which is documented by the insurer and the insurance certificate notes that the policy includes a deductible stipulation in accordance with the aforementioned Regulations.
4.2 The deductible which the insurer may set-off from the insurance benefits -upon the occurrence of an insured event which is covered by this policy, upon fulfillment of the conditions appearing in sub-paragraph 4.1 - shall be calculated in accordance with the type of damage caused and shall not exceed NIS 25,000 in regard to non-pecuniary damages and 7 working days in regard to loss of earnings.
5. Territorial applicability
The insurer 's liability in accordance with this policy shall apply if the insured event occurs within the boundaries of the State of Israel or the areas and territories detailed in paragraph 3(c) of the Insurance Ordinance, subject to whatsoever appearing therein, however, without derogating from the generalities of paragraph 2(a.1) of the Compensation Law.
